title: session-load --paid passes only --allowedTools, so a paid session's tools are not limited to Read, git status and rag.py as its gate chose
goal: bench_load.paid_argv passes --tools Read,Bash and --permission-mode dontAsk beside its allow list of Read, git status and rag.py

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bench_load as b
a = b.paid_argv('A')
assert '--tools' in a or ('--permission-mode' in a and 'dontAsk' in a), ('a paid session is not limited to its tools', [x for x in a if x.startswith('--')])

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bench_load as b
rules = ["Read", "Bash(git status:*)", "Bash(python3 _tools/rag.py:*)"]
assert b.PAID_TOOLS.split(",") == rules, ("the allow list is not Read, git status and rag.py", b.PAID_TOOLS)
for arm in ("A", "C", "D", "worker"):
    a = b.paid_argv(arm)
    val = lambda flag: a[a.index(flag) + 1] if flag in a else None
    assert val("--tools") == "Read,Bash", ("arm " + arm + " passes no --tools Read,Bash", val("--tools"))
    assert val("--permission-mode") == "dontAsk", ("arm " + arm + " passes no --permission-mode dontAsk", val("--permission-mode"))
    assert val("--allowedTools") == b.PAID_TOOLS, ("arm " + arm + " lost its allow list", val("--allowedTools"))
    assert arm != "D" or all(x in a for x in b.NO_HOOKS), "arm D lost its hooks-off flags"

options: --tools Read,Bash and --permission-mode dontAsk beside the allow list: Edit, Write and Agent are gone, and a Bash command the clone's own .claude/settings.json allows still runs
